description: Explore appliance product types, electrical specifications, OEM sourcing questions and supplier verification checklists.
hero: Understand the appliance behind the label.
intro: From electrical requirements to OEM documentation, explore practical comparisons and questions for manufacturers before your next sourcing decision.
heroCardCopy: Voltage, frequency, plug, energy and safety requirements differ by destination market.

topics.title: Market compatibility
topics.summary: Compare voltage/frequency, plugs, language and destination-market requirements.

topics.title: OEM vs ODM
topics.summary: Know who owns the design, tooling, certification evidence and brand assets.

topics.title: Quality and after-sales
topics.summary: Define spare parts, sampling, labeling and warranty responsibilities early.

products.name: Electric kettle
products.spec: Voltage/frequency, power, capacity, cut-off protection, materials.
products.caution: Electrical conformity depends on destination market and model.

products.name: Air fryer
products.description: Countertop cooking appliance using circulating heated air.
products.spec: Rated power, capacity, thermal controls, accessories, testing.
products.caution: Ask for model-specific safety and food-contact documentation.

products.name: Cordless vacuum cleaner
products.spec: Battery chemistry, charging specifications, service parts, runtime test.
products.caution: Battery shipping regulations and recycling rules may apply.

products.name: Portable fan
products.description: Compact air-moving appliance for personal or room use.
products.spec: Rated voltage, fan performance method, noise data, safety guards.
products.caution: Verify claims against a stated test method.

products.name: Induction cooktop
products.description: Electric cooking surface using magnetic induction.
products.spec: Power rating, supply connection, cookware compatibility, controls.
products.caution: Check electrical installation needs and local standards.

products.name: Steam iron
products.description: Handheld appliance for pressing and removing garment wrinkles.
products.spec: Voltage, power, water system, thermal protection, cord specification.
products.caution: Model identification and test reports must match the supplied item.

guides.title: OEM appliance RFQ checklist
guides.summary: Move beyond generic photos toward an auditable product specification.
checks: State model, quantity, packaging and destination market.
Request exact test report model and certificate scope.
Clarify tooling ownership, warranty and spare-parts support.

guides.title: Voltage and plug requirements
guides.summary: A plug adapter alone does not make every appliance suitable.
checks: Check both voltage and frequency ratings.
Identify the required plug and protective earthing design.
Confirm local conformity requirements before sale.

guides.title: Compare sampling and inspection
guides.summary: Agree on tolerances and acceptance rules before paying for bulk production.
checks: Define sample sign-off and any golden sample.
List safety-critical inspection and functional tests.
Specify third-party inspection and rejection rules in the contract.

faq.question: Can every appliance work worldwide?
faq.answer: No. Voltage, frequency, safety certification, plug and labeling requirements differ by market.

faq.question: Can I place an OEM order here?
faq.answer: Not yet. This is an independent reference website prototype.

faq.question: Does PENG certify factories?
faq.answer: No. Any future verification activity must describe who checked what, when and by which method.

disclosure: Product information is educational and does not establish electrical safety certification, importer obligations or approval to sell.
